title: Coordinated release experiment timeline with cross-functional ops escalation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket defines a coordinated experiment timeline and milestone checklist for releases that require cross-functional alignment (Product, Eng, SRE, and Design). Goal: run progressive experiments (small A/B cohorts, region-scoped canaries, and phased ramping) with deterministic telemetry contracts and a clear escalation ladder so rollouts can proceed autonomously up to a safe threshold. Deliverables: (1) canonical milestone timeline that maps to cycles and release windows, (2) telemetry contract (required metrics, aggregation windows, alert thresholds), (3) automated gating rules encoded in the deployment pipeline, (4) runbook for ops escalation including who to page and when, and (5) post-mortem template and regression detection tasks. This ticket will coordinate with ENG teams implementing the gating hooks, SRE for alerting and runbook validation, and Design for UX exposure limits on experiment cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: A milestone timeline PDF (linked in files) exists and is synced with the release calendar
Telemetry contract document specifies primary and secondary metrics, sampling cadence, and SLIs with numeric thresholds
Automated gating rules merged to the canary pipeline and validated in staging by the ENG team
Ops escalation runbook published and tested in a tabletop drill with SRE and on-call participants
Post-launch monitoring dashboard template created and made available in Grafana; alerts wired to PagerDuty with playbook links
comments: 2026-02-16 — Kickoff: aligned on scope with SRE (Liam Ortiz) and ENG (Priya Rao). Agreed canonical phases: PREVIEW -> CANARY (1%) -> REGIONAL_RAMP -> GLOBAL_RAMP -> GA. Action: PM to produce timeline artifact by EOD 2026-02-18.

2026-02-19 — Draft telemetry contract posted to Confluence. Primary metrics: p50/p95 latency, token-cost-per-request, model-fallback-rate, error-rate (5xx/4xx split), end-to-end success rate. Request sampling cadence: 1s latency buckets; aggregation window: 5m. Action: ENG to validate feasibility of metric collection (ENG-3182).

2026-02-26 — SRE tabletop completed. Identified gap: no explicit automated rollback hook for sustained p95 > 2x baseline over 10m. Assigned ENG-3182 to implement a rollback policy and PagerDuty integration. Added a manual escalation step for product owners at 2x threshold.

2026-02-28 — Reviewed gating rule proposal in infra PR. Feedback from Marco Chen: require a dry-run flag and canary to snapshot KV cache behavior before traffic ramp. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/642

2026-03-01 — Decision: use cohort-based A/B allocation for user-visible changes and region-based canaries for infra/runtime changes. Follow-ups: Design to provide UI exposure caps; Compliance to review experiment data retention policy next week.

2026-03-01 — Next steps: complete gating automation tests in staging (assigned to ENG-2921), run a rehearsed canary for the internal beta cohort on 2026-03-10, and finalize runbook updates by 2026-03-08.
